mapper.sql: b.id, b.tenant_id as tenantId, b.material_id as materialId, b.charge_item_id as chargeItemId, b.effective_from as effectiveFrom, b.effective_to as effectiveTo, b.bind_by as bindBy, b.unbind_by as unbindBy, b.create_time as createTime, b.update_time as updateTime, m.code as materialCode, m.name as materialName, cim.item_code as chargeItemCode, cim.item_name as chargeItemName, case when b.effective_to is null then 'Y' else 'N' end as currentFlag

from fd_material_his_charge_bind b left join fd_material m on m.id = b.material_id left join his_charge_item_mirror cim on cim.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and cim.charge_item_id = b.charge_item_id and (cim.deleted_flag is null or cim.deleted_flag != 1)
